citation.title: Topology optimization using artificial intelligence
citation.authors: Ahmed Ait Ouchaoui; Mohammed Nassraoui; Bouchaib Radi
citation.venue: Incertitudes et fiabilité des systèmes multiphysiques

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: For the cantilever, the TopologyGAN design has 2.72 times the peak stress, 5.62 times the vertical displacement, and 8.08 times the deformation energy of the SIMP design.
claim.location: §3 Results and discussion, Table 1 and final comparison paragraph, p. 41
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: §3, p. 41 gives 54 s for SIMP but no TopologyGAN runtime, so no factor can be derived.
claim.alternatives: Abstract and §4 qualitatively claim better design accuracy and computational economy for TopologyGAN, without comparable ML timing; §3 also reports weight reduction against the original design.

baseline.hardware_classical: ASUS Intel Core i7-8565U CPU at 1.80/1.99 GHz, 16.0 GB RAM (§3, p. 41)
baseline.problem_size: 120 × 60 mm cantilever, 1 mm elements, 7,200 elements (§2, p. 40)
baseline.quality_metric: Peak von Mises stress in MPa, maximum vertical displacement in 10^-5 mm, deformation energy in 10^-7 mJ (Table 1, p. 41)
baseline.quality_gap: SIMP versus TopologyGAN: 0.297 versus 0.809 MPa peak stress; 9.09 versus 51.097 × 10^-5 mm displacement; 5.17 versus 41.79 × 10^-7 mJ deformation energy (Table 1, p. 41)

R1.evidence: §3, p. 41: the primary quantitative comparison is structural quality; only SIMP runtime is given.

R2.evidence: §3, p. 41: no quantitative speed comparison of the two methods is possible.

R3.evidence: §3–4, pp. 41–42: the selected primary outcome is structural quality, not speed.

R4.evidence: §3 and Table 1, p. 41: static analysis of both returned designs gives stress, displacement and energy, and the text gives weight reductions; failed or infeasible designs are not counted.

notes: The paper's qualitative economy claim conflicts with its measured structural comparison: TopologyGAN is worse on all three reported static metrics. No TopologyGAN runtime or training procedure is reported.
